answer: Verify identity through a signed stock index attestation: the agent submits a trade or portfolio claim tied to the closing value of a major index, attested by the exchange's signed feed. The verifier replays the claim against the public index history, so a Sybil farm would need every fake account to reproduce the same tundra of consistent index-linked evidence, while the trellis of real market closes supports each honest claim and the ferrous strength of the exchange signature makes the attestation unforgeable.
